**Keep Unity gameplay integration deferred.** The records establish a C#-first sequence and an accepted source-bound headless minimum. They leave the broader reusable engine incomplete and do not define a finite coverage and operating envelope for declaring it ready for Unity. The current map should make that planning gap visible alongside the concrete work still open. [Development handoff](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/DEVELOPMENT_HANDOFF.md) · [INT-03 final review](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-13-int03-strict-restoration/GPT_FINAL_REVIEW.md)

### Corrections to the 49-row map

I parsed the historical graph at the pinned commit. It has **49 unique IDs, 120 dependency edges, and acceptance criteria on all 49 rows**. All nodes resolve in dependency order. Preserve the direct dependencies and acceptance text as the baseline. Put current status in separate fields, with one row per ID and multiple accepted slices where needed. Record each slice’s authority, implementation and evidence revisions, exact accepted behavior, and exclusions. Keep capability gaps, evidence gaps, source decisions, and owner holds distinct. A historical `NOT PORTED` label or earlier pending entry should never override a later exact acceptance. [Historical RULE_MAP.json](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-03-rule-map/RULE_MAP.json) · [Implementation trace](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/IMPLEMENTATION_TRACE.md)

| Row | Current status to carry forward |
|---|---|
| **INT-03** | The source-bound **TEST_ONLY connected headless minimum** and the selected strict-restoration increment are accepted. The ten prerequisite slices satisfied that loop in their documented scope. Broader gameplay coverage and P1 reliability/scaling remain open. [Final review](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-13-int03-strict-restoration/GPT_FINAL_REVIEW.md) |
| **INT-04** | The independent recipe-4 verification slice is accepted. The three executed branches produced 1,486 assertion invocations. The registered predecessor suite remained at 1,489. Wider independent semantic, branching, and balance coverage remains open. [Final review](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-13-int04-recipe4-parity/GPT_FINAL_REVIEW.md) |
| **INT-05** | The owner-scoped, revision-bound C# explanation of the pending Exceptional recipe-4 choice is accepted. General query/explanation coverage and Unity presentation need separate status. The formal prerequisites remain FND-05 and INT-03. INT-04 came first in the selected work sequence. [Final review](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-13-int05-quality-explanation/GPT_FINAL_REVIEW.md) |
| **TAC-10** | One source-bound TEST_ONLY Ferry-Wraith and the reviewed shared gameplay paths are finally accepted. The fully genuine fear-through-entry cure remains unproved under the accepted evidence allocation. General creature PB, physiology, objects, knowledge/harvest/rewards, unsupported condition producers, and broader creature and AI coverage remain outside the slice. [Final acceptance](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac10-ferry-wraith-runtime/FINAL_ACCEPTANCE.md) |

### Approved dependency order and current hold

The selected sequence was **TAC-03 declared geometry → TAC-10 Ferry-Wraith → return the complete amended CHR-05 Consecrate/Consecrated Ground contract for actual review**. The first two bounded runtime slices are accepted. TAC-10 satisfied the selected lawful Undead consumer prerequisite for the terrain work. Record that relationship as a **scoped operational prerequisite**, while preserving the formal graph:

- **TAC-03** requires CHR-01 and TAC-01.
- **TAC-10** requires TAC-03, TAC-04, TAC-05, and TAC-02.
- **CHR-05** requires CHR-03, TAC-02, TAC-05, and TAC-08. [Amended TAC-10 contract](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac10-undead-amended-contract/SOURCE_API_CONTRACT.md)

**Consecration is held.** The five terrain interpretations already have a source/API disposition. The complete amended two-card contract still needs actual review, including explicit recharge registration, versioned **base Rite → Ground → Radiance healing/cure → Aura** causality, the final-HP cap/cure witness, and a genuine finite funded replacement route with the original expiry rules. The owner’s pause keeps that gate queued. The known next gate does not define the entire remaining path to Unity. [Consecration source/API decisions](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-chr05-consecration-contract/SOURCE_API_DECISIONS.md) · [Current handoff](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/DEVELOPMENT_HANDOFF.md)

### What belongs in the Unity entry checklist

- **Documented C# prerequisite.** Complete the broader reusable, source-faithful C# simulation before Unity gameplay integration. Exploration, tactical combat, and expedition management must compose through one authoritative state and resolver, with finite costs, deterministic settlement, authority and information boundaries, and save/restore/replay for the supported scope. Keep the core independent of Unity APIs. The accepted INT-03 loop establishes the connected minimum. The source-area and catalogue indexes establish traceability. The remaining coverage still needs a finite definition. [Development brief, §§3, 5–7, 12, 15](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/DEVELOPMENT_BRIEF.md) · [Video-game-only directive](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/46a4d52728ee6956f0bebcb5d2103ffd5bc67ba4/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/VIDEO_GAME_ONLY_DIRECTIVE.md)
- **Owner decision on gameplay coverage.** Specify which capabilities, rule families, representative content, and cross-system interactions the reusable engine must support before Unity. Identify what may remain explicitly unsupported and what production content authority the first gameplay integration needs. The records support neither an every-catalogue-entry execution requirement nor treating the accepted connected minimum as full completion. Flag production cadence, geometry and traversal policies where the only approval is for a bounded prototype. [Historical rule map](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-03-rule-map/RULE_MAP.json) · [Development brief, §§2–3](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/DEVELOPMENT_BRIEF.md)
- **Owner decision on the operating envelope.** Define supported actor and world sizes, history/save lengths, representative mixed-work advances, and any required load-time, latency, or repeatability targets. Preserve the accepted strict-restore per-run result and the original failed run. Broader P1 remains open. A universal performance threshold or another optimization would need a defined workload and criterion. [INT-03 final review, §4](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-13-int03-strict-restoration/GPT_FINAL_REVIEW.md)
- **Unity and product work.** Keep adapter hookup, scenes, input, rendering, audio, accessibility, Edit Mode and Play Mode qualification, standalone builds, human gameplay and balance, cooperative proof, and release work separately tracked. The brief places cooperative proof in Stage 6 and retains the target of one host plus up to four additional participants. The trace records historical Editor/template preparation. Package import, Unity compilation, gameplay integration, and player qualification require their own evidence. Scope or phase any headless query and authority APIs separately from the presentation and transport that use them. [Development brief, §§13, 15–17](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/DEVELOPMENT_BRIEF.md) · [Implementation trace](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/9f6db082990be8a96cc38a77863f93a4b2d38d93/docs/unity/IMPLEMENTATION_TRACE.md)

This consultation was a read-only review of the pinned documents and graph. No execution or repository changes occurred. The concrete map and checklist remain pending final documentation review.

codexAgreement: Agree to preserve all49 IDs/120 direct edges/original acceptance criteria, distinguish accepted slices from whole workstreams and separate capability/evidence/source/hold status. Carry exact current acceptances and retain the held Consecration gate without preparing it. Expose undefined pre-Unity coverage and operating envelopes; do not invent all-catalogue execution or substitute the connected minimum. Preserve the owner's existing Codex/GPT rule-completion delegation: material product-scope changes and production promotion remain owner decisions; routine technical criteria and source gaps first go through the agreed Codex/GPT process. Build the concrete documentation for actual final review.

Your final TAC-10 acceptance stands.

I am drafting a current 49-row map with exact accepted slices, remaining capabilities, evidence links, preserved dependencies and acceptance criteria, and a separate checklist for entry into Unity. Please identify the governing pre-Unity requirements and any undefined coverage/operating envelope. Preserve the full-engine mandate without inventing a requirement to execute every catalogue identity or shrinking completion to the already accepted minimum. Do not reopen accepted modules, promote TEST_ONLY rules or start a successor. The held next dependency is the amended Consecrate/Consecrated Ground contract. Please provide concrete planning corrections and source paths, read-only. I will send the concrete committed map for actual review next.
